lessons.title: Alphabet & Pronunciation
lessons.explanation: Ingliz tilida 26 ta harf va 44 ta tovush mavjud. Harflar unli (vowels) va undosh (consonants) turlarga bo'linadi.
lessons.rule: Harflarning nomi va ularning so'z ichida o'qilishi farq qilishi mumkin.
lessons.formula: Alphabet = 26 Letters (5 Vowels + 21 Consonants)

examples.en: Apple
Cat

quiz.questionUz: Ingliz alifbosida nechta unli (vowel) harf bor?
quiz.explanation: Ingliz alifbosida 5 ta unli harf bor: A, E, I, O, U.

lessons.title: Subject Pronouns — I, you, he, she, it, we, they
lessons.explanation: Kishilik olmoshlari gapda ega vazifasida keladi va harakatni kim bajarayotganini ko'rsatadi.
lessons.rule: Kishilik olmoshlari har doim fe'ldan oldin keladi.
lessons.formula: Subject Pronoun + Verb

examples.en: I am a student.
They play football.

quiz.questionUz: 'Ular' so'zining inglizcha tarjimasini toping:
quiz.explanation: 'They' olmoshi 'Ular' degan ma'noni anglatadi.

lessons.title: Verb “to be” — am, is, are
lessons.explanation: 'To be' fe'li bo'lish, shaxs, joy yoki holatni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.
lessons.rule: I -> am | He/She/It -> is | We/You/They -> are
lessons.formula: Positive: Subject + am/is/are | Negative: Subject + am/is/are + not

examples.en: She is a doctor.
We are happy.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'g'ri to'ldiring: 'He ___ (be) my friend.'
quiz.explanation: 'He' olmoshi bilan 'is' fe'li ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Possessive Adjectives — my, your, his, her...
lessons.explanation: Egalik sifatlari buyum yoki shaxsning kimga tegishli ekanligini ko'rsatadi.
lessons.rule: Egalik sifatlaridan keyin har doim ot (noun) kelishi shart.
lessons.formula: Possessive Adjective + Noun

examples.en: This is my book.
Her name is Anna.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri egalik sifatini tanlang: 'John is driving ___ car.'
quiz.explanation: John er kishi bo'lgani uchun 'his' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Plural Nouns — book/books
lessons.explanation: Otlar ko'plik shaklga o'tganda qo'shimchalar qabul qiladi.
lessons.rule: Aksariyat otlarga '-s' qo'shiladi. '-ch, -sh, -s, -x, -z' bilan tugasa '-es' qo'shiladi.
lessons.formula: Noun + -s / -es

examples.en: One book -> Two books
One box -> Three boxes

quiz.questionUz: 'Box' so'zining ko'plik shaklini yozing:
quiz.explanation: '-x' harfi bilan tugagan otlarga '-es' qo'shiladi.

lessons.title: Articles — a, an, the
lessons.explanation: Artikllar otlarning aniq yoki noaniq ekanligini ko'rsatadi.
lessons.rule: 'A' undosh tovushdan, 'An' unli tovushdan oldin keladi. 'The' aniq narsalar uchun ishlatiladi.
lessons.formula: a/an + Singular Countable Noun | the + Specific Noun

examples.en: I have an apple.
The sun is bright.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri artiklni tanlang: 'She is ___ university student.'
quiz.explanation: 'University' so'zi unli harf bilan boshlansada, [ju:] undosh tovush bilan aytiladi.

lessons.title: Demonstratives — this, that, these, those
lessons.explanation: Ko'rsatish olmoshlari narsalarning yaqin yoki uzoqligini va birlik/ko'plikda ekanligini ko'rsatadi.
lessons.rule: Yaqin: This (birlik), These (ko'plik) | Uzoq: That (birlik), Those (ko'plik)
lessons.formula: This/That + Singular | These/Those + Plural

examples.en: This is a pen.
Those are birds.

quiz.questionUz: Uzoqdagi ko'plikdagi narsalar uchun qaysi olmosh ishlatiladi?
quiz.explanation: Uzoqdagi ko'plik obyektlar uchun 'Those' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: There is / There are
lessons.explanation: Biror joyda narsa yoki shaxsning mavjudligini aytish uchun ishlatiladi.
lessons.rule: There is + Birlik ot | There are + Ko'plik ot
lessons.formula: There is/are + Noun + Place

examples.en: There is a book on the table.
There are three cats here.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: '___ two chairs in the room.'
quiz.explanation: 'Two chairs' ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun 'There are' bo'ladi.

lessons.title: Have / Has
lessons.explanation: Egalik va nimagadir ega ekanlikni ko'rsatuvchi fe'l.
lessons.rule: I/You/We/They -> have | He/She/It -> has
lessons.formula: Subject + have/has + Object

examples.en: I have a car.
He has a sister.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri fe'lni tanlang: 'She ___ a new laptop.'
quiz.explanation: 'She' uchunchi shaxs birlik bilan 'has' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Present Simple
lessons.explanation: Odatda, doimiy yoki takrorlanib turadigan harakatlarni ifodalaydi.
lessons.rule: He/She/It bo'lsa fe'lga '-s' yoki '-es' qo'shiladi.
lessons.formula: I/You/We/They + V1 | He/She/It + V1(-s/-es)

examples.en: I work every day.
She plays tennis.

quiz.questionUz: To'g mezonni tanlang: 'He ___ English every day.'
quiz.explanation: 'He' bilan fe'l 'studies' shakliga o'tadi.

lessons.title: Present Simple: Negative & Questions
lessons.explanation: Present Simple zamonida inkor va so'roq gaplarni hosil qilish.
lessons.rule: Inkor: don't / doesn't + V1 | So'roq: Do / Does + Subject + V1?
lessons.formula: Neg: Subject + don't/doesn't + V1 | Ques: Do/Does + Subject + V1?

examples.en: I don't like coffee.
Does she speak English?

quiz.questionUz: Inkor shaklini yozing: 'They ___ (not / live) here.'
quiz.explanation: 'They' olmoshi uchun 'don't' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Adverbs of Frequency — always, usually, often...
lessons.explanation: Harakatning qanchalik tez-tez sodir bo'lishini ko'rsatuvchi ravishlar.
lessons.rule: Chastota ravishlari asosiy fe'ldan oldin, 'to be' fe'lidan keyin keladi.
lessons.formula: Subject + Adverb + Main Verb | Subject + To Be + Adverb

examples.en: I always wake up early.
She is never late.

quiz.questionUz: Gapdagi ravish o'rnini to'g'ri tanlang:
quiz.explanation: Chastota ravishi asosiy fe'ldan oldin joylashadi.

lessons.title: Prepositions of Place — in, on, under, next to...
lessons.explanation: Narsa yoki shaxsning qayerda joylashganini ko'rsatuvchi predloglar.
lessons.rule: In (ichida), On (ustida), Under (ostida), Next to (yonida).
lessons.formula: Subject + Verb + Preposition + Place

examples.en: The cat is under the table.
The key is in my pocket.

quiz.questionUz: 'Stol ustida' birikmasi uchun to'g'ri predlog:
quiz.explanation: Sirt ustida bo'lsa 'on' predlogi ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Prepositions of Time — in, on, at
lessons.explanation: Vaqt va sanalarni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladigan predloglar.
lessons.rule: At (aniq soat/vaqt) | On (kunlar va sanalar) | In (oylar, yillar, fasllar).
lessons.formula: at + time | on + day/date | in + month/year/season

examples.en: The party is on Friday.
I sleep at 11 PM.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri predlogni yozing: 'My birthday is ___ July.'
quiz.explanation: Oylar nomi bilan 'in' predlogi ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Imperatives — Open the door!
lessons.explanation: Buyruq, iltimos yoki ko'rsatma berish uchun ishlatiladigan gaplar.
lessons.rule: Buyruq gaplar egasiz (subject) va fe'lning birinchi shakli bilan boshlanadi.
lessons.formula: Positive: Verb1! | Negative: Don't + Verb1!

examples.en: Close the window, please.
Don't run here!

quiz.questionUz: Salbiy buyruq gapni tanlang:
quiz.explanation: Salbiy buyruq gaplar 'Don't + V1' bilan hosil qilinadi.

lessons.title: Can / Can't
lessons.explanation: Qobiliyat, imkoniyat yoki ruxsatni ifodalovchi modal fe'l.
lessons.rule: 'Can'dan keyin fe'lga hech qanday qo'shimcha qo'shilmaydi.
lessons.formula: Subject + can/can't + V1

examples.en: I can swim.
He can't drive a car.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: 'She can ___ fast.'
quiz.explanation: 'Can' modal fe'lidan keyin fe'lning o'zi (V1) keladi.

lessons.title: Countable & Uncountable Nouns
lessons.explanation: Sanaladigan (Countable) va sanalmaydigan (Uncountable) otlar.
lessons.rule: Sanaladigan otlar ko'plikka o'tadi, sanalmaydigan otlar faqat birlikda ishlatiladi.
lessons.formula: Countable: book -> books | Uncountable: water, sugar, money

examples.en: An apple / Three apples
Water (NOT waters)

quiz.questionUz: Qaysi ot sanalmaydi (uncountable)?
quiz.explanation: Suyuqliklar (Milk) sanalmaydigan otlar guruhiga kiradi.

lessons.title: Some / Any
lessons.explanation: Biroz, bir qancha ma'nolarini beruvchi aniqlovchilar.
lessons.rule: 'Some' darak gaplarda, 'Any' inkor va so'roq gaplarda ishlatiladi.
lessons.formula: Positive: some + Noun | Negative/Question: any + Noun

examples.en: I have some bread.
Do you have any apples?

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'I don't have ___ money.'
quiz.explanation: Inkor gaplarda 'any' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Much / Many / A lot of
lessons.explanation: Ko'p miqdordagi narsa va shaxslarni ifodalash.
lessons.rule: Many + Sanaladigan otlar | Much + Sanalmaydigan otlar | A lot of + Ikkalasi uchun (darak gapda).
lessons.formula: Many + Plural | Much + Uncountable | A lot of + All

examples.en: There are many friends here.
How much water do you drink?

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri so'zni tanlang: 'How ___ books do you have?'
quiz.explanation: Books sanaladigan ot bo'lgani uchun 'many' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Basic Question Words — who, what, where, when, why, how
lessons.explanation: Maxsus so'roq gaplar tuzish uchun ishlatiladigan so'roq so'zlari.
lessons.rule: So'roq so'zlari har doim gapning eng boshida keladi.
lessons.formula: Wh-word + Auxiliary Verb + Subject + Main Verb?

examples.en: Where do you live?
What is your name?

quiz.questionUz: 'Qachon' ma'nosini beruvchi so'roq so'zini toping:
quiz.explanation: 'When' vaqtga nisbatan 'Qachon' deb tarjima qilinadi.

lessons.title: Present Continuous
lessons.explanation: Ayni damda sodir bo'layotgan harakat va holatlarni ifodalaydi.
lessons.rule: Subject + am/is/are + Verb(-ing)
lessons.formula: Positive: S + am/is/are + V-ing | Negative: S + am/is/are + not + V-ing

examples.en: I am reading a book right now.
They are playing football.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'Listen! The baby ___.'
quiz.explanation: 'Listen!' signal so'zi harakat hozir sodir bo'layotganini ko'rsatadi.

lessons.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
lessons.explanation: Doimiy takrorlanadigan odatlar (Present Simple) va ayni damda yuz berayotgan harakatlar (Present Continuous) o'rtasidagi farq.
lessons.rule: Odatlar uchun V1/-s, ayni damdagi harakat uchun am/is/are + V-ing ishlatiladi.
lessons.formula: Present Simple (Routine) vs Present Continuous (Now)

examples.en: I usually drink tea, but today I am drinking coffee.
examples.uz: Men odatda choy ichaman, lekin bugun kofe ichyapman.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: 'He usually ___ to work, but today he ___ by bus.'
quiz.explanation: Birinchi qism odat (Present Simple), ikkinchisi bugungi istisno (Present Continuous).

lessons.title: Past Simple: was/were
lessons.explanation: 'To be' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli. O'tmishdagi holat yoki joylashuvni ko'rsatadi.
lessons.rule: I/He/She/It -> was | We/You/They -> were
lessons.formula: Positive: Subject + was/were | Negative: Subject + was/were + not

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
They were very happy.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'We ___ (be) at the park last Sunday.'
quiz.explanation: 'We' olmoshi uchun o'tgan zamonda 'were' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Past Simple: Regular & Irregular Verbs
lessons.explanation: O'tgan zamonda tugallangan harakatlar. To'g'ri (Regular) va noto'g'ri (Irregular) fe'llar.
lessons.rule: To'g'ri fe'llarga '-ed' qo'shiladi, noto'g'ri fe mezonlar 2-shakliga (V2) o'zgaradi.
lessons.formula: Subject + V2 (-ed or Irregular form)

examples.en: I watched a movie yesterday.
She went to Paris last year.

quiz.questionUz: 'Go' fe'lining Past Simple shakli qaysi?
quiz.explanation: 'Go' noto'g'ri fe'l bo'lib, o'tgan zamonda 'went'ga o'zgaradi.

lessons.title: Past Simple: Negative & Questions
lessons.explanation: Past Simple zamonida inkor va so'roq gaplar yasash.
lessons.rule: Inkor: didn't + V1 | So'roq: Did + Subject + V1?
lessons.formula: Neg: S + didn't + V1 | Ques: Did + S + V1?

examples.en: I didn't see him yesterday.
Did you call me last night?

quiz.questionUz: Inkor shaklini yozing: 'She ___ (not / buy) the car.'
quiz.explanation: Past Simple inkorda 'didn't'dan keyin fe'lning 1-shakli keladi.

lessons.title: Past Continuous
lessons.explanation: O'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etayotgan bo'lgan harakatlar.
lessons.rule: Subject + was/were + Verb(-ing)
lessons.formula: Positive: S + was/were + V-ing | Negative: S + was/were + not + V-ing

examples.en: I was studying at 8 PM last night.
examples.uz: Kecha soat 8 da dars qilayotgan edim.

examples.en: They were sleeping when I arrived.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: 'What ___ you doing at 10 PM?'
quiz.explanation: 'You' olmoshi uchun Past Continuous'da 'were' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Past Simple vs Past Continuous
lessons.explanation: O'tmishda davom etayotgan harakatni (Past Continuous) boshqa qisqa harakat (Past Simple) bo'lib qo'yishi.
lessons.rule: While + Past Continuous | When + Past Simple
lessons.formula: Past Continuous + when + Past Simple

examples.en: I was watching TV when the phone rang.
examples.uz: Telefon jiringlaganda men televizor ko'rayotgan edim.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri birikmani tanlang: 'While I ___ (cook), I ___ (cut) my finger.'
quiz.explanation: 'While'dan keyin davomli zamon (was cooking), kesib olish qisqa harakat (cut).

lessons.title: Future: be going to
lessons.explanation: Oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyat va qarorlar hamda aniq belgilarga asoslangan kelajak taxminlari.
lessons.rule: Subject + am/is/are + going to + Verb1
lessons.formula: S + am/is/are + going to + V1

examples.en: I am going to buy a new laptop.
Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'She ___ (be / go) to start a new job next month.'
quiz.explanation: 'She' uchun 'is going to' strukturasi ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Future: will
lessons.explanation: Tezkor qarorlar, kelajakdagi taxminlar va va'dalar uchun ishlatiladigan kelasi zamon.
lessons.rule: Subject + will + Verb1 | Subject + won't + Verb1
lessons.formula: S + will + V1

examples.en: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
I will help you with your homework.

quiz.questionUz: Inkor shaklini tanlang: 'I ___ forget your kindness.'
quiz.explanation: 'Will not' qisqartmasi 'won't' shaklida yoziladi.

lessons.title: Will vs Going to
lessons.explanation: Spontan tezkor qarorlar (Will) va oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyatlar (Going to) o'rtasidagi farq.
lessons.rule: Will = kutilmagan instant qaror | Going to = reja/niyat
lessons.formula: Spontaneous Decision (Will) vs Pre-planned (Going to)

examples.en: The phone is ringing. I will answer it!

quiz.questionUz: A: 'Why are you holding a bucket?' B: 'I ___ wash the car.'
quiz.explanation: Paqir ushlab turgani rejasi borligini ko'rsatadi (Going to).

lessons.title: Comparative Adjectives
lessons.explanation: Ikki narsa yoki shaxsni bir-biri bilan solishtirish uchun ishlatiladigan sifatlar.
lessons.rule: Qisqa sifatlar + -er than | Uzun sifatlar -> more + sifat + than
lessons.formula: Short: Adj + er + than | Long: more + Adj + than

examples.en: An elephant is bigger than a horse.
This car is more expensive than that one.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri solishtirish shaklini tanlang: 'Summer is ___ than winter.'
quiz.explanation: Qisqa 'hot' sifatiga '-er' qo'shiladi va 't' ikkilanadi (hotter).

lessons.title: Superlative Adjectives
lessons.explanation: Uch va undan ortiq narsalar orasidan eng ustunini ko'rsatuvchi sifat darajasi.
lessons.rule: the + Qisqa sifat + -est | the most + Uzun sifat
lessons.formula: Short: the + Adj + est | Long: the most + Adj

examples.en: Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

quiz.questionUz: Sifatning orttirma shaklini yozing: 'He is the ___ (tall) boy in class.'
quiz.explanation: 'Tall' qisqa sifat bo'lgani uchun '-est' qo'shiladi.

lessons.title: Adverbs
lessons.explanation: Harakat qanday bajarilishini ko'rsatuvchi ravishlar (Adverbs of Manner).
lessons.rule: Odatda Sifat + -ly orqali yasaladi (quick -> quickly). Istisnolar: good -> well, fast -> fast.
lessons.formula: Verb + Adverb (Adj + -ly)

examples.en: He drives carefully.
She speaks English well.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri ravishni tanlang: 'She runs very ___.'
quiz.explanation: 'Fast' so'zi sifat va ravishda bir xil shaklga ega (fastly degan so'z yo'q).

lessons.title: Modal Verbs: should / shouldn't
lessons.explanation: Maslahat va tavsiyalar berish uchun ishlatiladigan modal fe'l.
lessons.rule: Subject + should / shouldn't + Verb1
lessons.formula: S + should/shouldn't + V1

examples.en: You look tired. You should sleep early.
You shouldn't drink cold water.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri modal fe'lni tanlang: 'It is raining. You ___ take an umbrella.'
quiz.explanation: Yomg'ir yog'ayotganda soyabon olish maslahat beriladi (should).

lessons.title: Must / Mustn't
lessons.explanation: Qat'iy majburiyat (Must) va taqiq (Mustn't)ni ifodalaydi.
lessons.rule: Must = majburiyat/shart | Mustn't = qat'iyan taqiqlangan harakat
lessons.formula: Subject + must/mustn't + V1

examples.en: You must stop at the red light.
You mustn't smoke here.

quiz.questionUz: Taqiq gapni to'ldiring: 'You ___ (not / touch) that high voltage wire.'
quiz.explanation: Xavfli va taqiqlangan harakatlar uchun 'mustn't' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Have to / Don't have to
lessons.explanation: Tashqi qoidalar sababli majburiyat (Have to) va majburiyatning yo'qligi (Don't have to).
lessons.rule: Don't have to = majbur emassan (xohlasang qil, xohlamasang yo'q).
lessons.formula: S + have to/has to + V1 | S + don't/doesn't have to + V1

examples.en: I have to wear a uniform at school.
Tomorrow is Sunday, so I don't have to get up early.
examples.uz: Ertaga yakshanba, shuning uchun erta turishga majbur emasman.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: 'She ___ work on weekends. It's her choice.'
quiz.explanation: Majburiyat yo'qligida 'She' uchun 'doesn't have to' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Object Pronouns — me, him, her, us...
lessons.explanation: To'ldiruvchi olmoshlar fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin keladi.
lessons.rule: I -> me | He -> him | She -> her | We -> us | They -> them
lessons.formula: Verb + Object Pronoun / Preposition + Object Pronoun

examples.en: Can you help me?
I saw him at the station.

quiz.questionUz: To'ldiruvchi olmoshni toping: 'Give the book to ___ (she).'
quiz.explanation: 'She' olmoshining to'ldiruvchi shakli 'her' bo'ladi.

lessons.title: Possessive Pronouns — mine, yours, theirs...
lessons.explanation: Egalik olmoshlari otning o'rnida ishlatiladi va o'zidan keyin ot talab qilmaydi.
lessons.rule: my book -> mine | your car -> yours | her house -> hers
lessons.formula: Possessive Pronoun (No noun after it)

examples.en: This pen is mine.
Is that car yours?

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'This bag belongs to me. It is ___.'
quiz.explanation: 'Meningniki' ma'nosini bera oladigan egalik olmoshi 'mine'.

lessons.title: Gerund (-ing)
lessons.explanation: Fe'lning '-ing' qo'shimchasi olib otga aylangan shakli (harakat nomi).
lessons.rule: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin (like, enjoy, hate, stop, finish) Gerund keladi.
lessons.formula: Verb + Verb(-ing)

examples.en: I enjoy swimming in the pool.
She hates doing homework.
examples.uz: U uy vazifasi qilishni yomon ko'radi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'He finished ___ the book.'
quiz.explanation: 'Finish' fe'lidan keyin fe'l har doim Gerund (-ing) shaklida keladi.

lessons.title: Infinitive: to + verb
lessons.explanation: Fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli va maqsadni ifodalash usuli.
lessons.rule: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin (want, decide, hope, plan, need) 'to + Verb1' keladi.
lessons.formula: Verb + to + Verb1

examples.en: I want to learn English.
They decided to travel to London.
examples.uz: Ular Londonga Sayohat qilishga qaror qilishdi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'She promised ___ me.'
quiz.explanation: 'Promise' fe'lidan keyin Infinitive (to + V1) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Present Perfect Simple: Experience
lessons.explanation: Hayotiy tajribalar va o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, lekin aniq vaqti ko'rsatilmagan harakatlar.
lessons.rule: Subject + have/has + V3 (Past Participle)
lessons.formula: Positive: S + have/has + V3 | Negative: S + have/has + not + V3

examples.en: I have visited London twice.
Have you ever eaten sushi?

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'She has never ___ (be) to Paris.'
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect zamonida fe'lning 3-shakli (V3) 'been' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Present Perfect: For vs Since
lessons.explanation: Harakatning qancha vaqt davom etganini (For) yoki qachon boshlanganini (Since) ko'rsatish.
lessons.rule: For + vaqt davomiyligi (2 years, 5 hours) | Since + boshlanish vaqti (2010, 8 AM, Monday)
lessons.formula: S + have/has + V3 + for/since + Time

examples.en: I have lived here for 5 years.
examples.uz: Men bu yerda 5 yildan beri yashayman.

examples.en: She has worked here since 2020.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri so'zni yozing: 'We have been friends ___ high school.'
quiz.explanation: Harakat boshlangan nuqta ko'rsatilgani uchun 'since' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
lessons.explanation: Natijasi hozirda ko'rinib turgan harakat (Present Perfect) va o'tmishda aniq vaqtda tugagan harakat (Past Simple).
lessons.rule: Aniq vaqt bo'lsa -> Past Simple (V2) | Natija hozir bo'lsa -> Present Perfect (have/has + V3)
lessons.formula: Past Simple (Finished Time) vs Present Perfect (Unfinished/Result)

examples.en: I lost my key. (I still don't have it)
I lost my key yesterday, but I found it.
examples.uz: Kecha kalitni yo'qotgan edim, lekin topdim.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: 'Shakespeare ___ many famous plays.'
quiz.explanation: Shekspir o'tmishda yashagani va vaqt tugagani uchun Past Simple (wrote) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Present Perfect Continuous
lessons.explanation: O'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha to'xtovsiz davom etayotgan harakatlar.
lessons.rule: Subject + have/has + been + Verb(-ing)
lessons.formula: S + have/has + been + V-ing

examples.en: It has been raining all morning.
How long have you been learning English?

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'She is tired because she ___ for 5 hours.'
quiz.explanation: Charchoq natijasi va 5 soatlik davomli harakat uchun Present Perfect Continuous mos keladi.

lessons.title: Past Perfect Simple
lessons.explanation: O'tmishdagi biror harakat yoki vaqtdan oldinroq sodir bo'lib o'tgan harakat.
lessons.rule: Subject + had + Verb3 (Past Participle)
lessons.formula: S + had + V3

examples.en: When I arrived, the train had already left.
examples.uz: Men yetib kelganimda, poyezd ketib bo'lgandi.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'They ___ (finish) the test before the bell rang.'
quiz.explanation: Qo'ng'iroq chalinishidan oldinroq tugagani uchun Past Perfect (had finished) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Zero & First Conditionals
lessons.explanation: Umumiy haqiqatlar (Zero) va kelajakda sodir bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan shartli gaplar (First).
lessons.rule: Zero: If + Present Simple, Present Simple | First: If + Present Simple, Will + V1
lessons.formula: If + S + V1, S + will + V1

examples.en: If you freeze water, it turns into ice. (Zero)
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home. (First)
examples.uz: Ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa, biz uyda qolamiz.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri javobni tanlang: 'If she ___ hard, she will pass the exam.'
quiz.explanation: First Conditional'da 'if' qismida Present Simple (studies) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Second Conditional
lessons.explanation: Hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi nohaqiqiy, faraziy vaziyatlar va gipotezalar.
lessons.rule: If + Past Simple, Subject + would + Verb1
lessons.formula: If + S + V2/were, S + would + V1

examples.en: If I had a million dollars, I would buy a yacht.
examples.uz: Agar bir million dollarim bo'lganda, yaxta sotib olardim.

examples.en: If I were you, I would consult a doctor.
examples.uz: Sening o'rningda bo'lganimda, shifokorga uchrayotgan bo'lardim.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'If he ___ more time, he would learn Spanish.'
quiz.explanation: Second Conditional'da 'if' qismida Past Simple (had) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Passive Voice: Present & Past Simple
lessons.explanation: Ega harakatni bajaruvchi emas, balki harakat ega ustida bajariladigan majhul nisbat.
lessons.rule: Present: am/is/are + V3 | Past: was/were + V3
lessons.formula: Subject + be + V3 (+ by agent)

examples.en: English is spoken all over the world.
This house was built in 1995.

quiz.questionUz: Majhul nisbatda yozing: 'The Mona Lisa ___ (paint) by Leonardo da Vinci.'
quiz.explanation: O'tgan zamondagi majhul nisbat uchun 'was painted' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Reported Speech: Statements
lessons.explanation: Boshqa kishining gapi va fikrini o'z so'zlari bilan o'zgartirib yetkazish (O'zlashtirma gap).
lessons.rule: Zamonaviy fe'llar bir zamon orqaga suriladi (Present -> Past).
lessons.formula: Direct: 'I am happy' -> Reported: He said that he was happy.

examples.en: Direct: 'I like music.' -> Reported: He said he liked music.
examples.uz: To'g'ri gap: 'Menga muzika yoqadi' -> O'zlashtirma: U muzikani yoqtirishini aytdi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri o'zlashtirma gapni tanlang: She said, 'I will call you.'
options: She said she would call me.
She said she will call me.
She told she would call me.
quiz.answer: She said she would call me.
quiz.explanation: 'Will' o'zlashtirma gapda 'would'ga o'zgaradi.

lessons.title: Relative Clauses: who, which, that
lessons.explanation: Shaxs yoki narsa haqida qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi ergash gaplar.
lessons.rule: Who (odamlar uchun) | Which (narsa/hayvonlar uchun) | That (ikkalasi uchun ham).
lessons.formula: Noun + who/which/that + Verb

examples.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
This is the book which I bought yesterday.
examples.uz: Bu men kecha sotib olgan kitob.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri nisbiy olmoshni tanlang: 'I know a girl ___ speaks 5 languages.'
quiz.explanation: 'Girl' insonga tegishli bo'lgani uchun 'who' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Modal Verbs of Deduction: must, can't, might
lessons.explanation: Mantiqiy xulosa chiqarish va ehtimollik darajasini ko'rsatuvchi modal fe'llar.
lessons.rule: Must (100% ishonch/ijobiy) | Can't (100% imkonsiz) | Might/May (50% ehtimol)
lessons.formula: Subject + must/can't/might + Verb1

examples.en: He drives a Ferrari. He must be rich.
examples.uz: U Ferrari haydaydi. U boy bo'lsa kerak.

examples.en: She can't be at home; I just saw her outside.
examples.uz: U uyda bo'lishi mumkin emas, men uni hozirgina ko'rdim.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri modal fe'lni tanlang: 'Look at those lights! It ___ be an alien ship, but I'm not sure.'
quiz.explanation: Aniq ishonch yo'q bo'lgani uchun (50% ehtimol) 'might' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Used to
lessons.explanation: O'tmishda muntazam bajarilgan, lekin hozirda to'xtatilgan odat va holatlar.
lessons.rule: Subject + used to + Verb1 | Negative: didn't use to + Verb1
lessons.formula: S + used to + V1

examples.en: I used to play video games, but now I don't.
examples.uz: Ilgari video o'yinlar o'ynardim, lekin hozir o'ynamayman.

quiz.questionUz: Inkor shaklini to'ldiring: 'He didn't ___ (use to) like vegetables.'
quiz.explanation: 'Didn't' ishlatilganda '-d' tushib qoladi va 'use to' shaklida yoziladi.

lessons.title: So / Neither do I (Agreement)
lessons.explanation: Boshqa kishining fikri yoki harakatiga qo'shilish va rozilik bildirish usuli.
lessons.rule: Ijobiy gapga qo'shilish: So + Auxiliary + I | Salbiy gapga qo'shilish: Neither + Auxiliary + I
lessons.formula: So + Aux + S | Neither + Aux + S

examples.en: A: 'I love coffee.' B: 'So do I.'
A: 'I can't swim.' B: 'Neither can I.'
examples.uz: A: 'Men suza olmayman.' B: 'Men ham (suza olmayman).'

quiz.questionUz: A: 'I don't like horror movies.' B: '___'
quiz.explanation: Inkor gapga rozilik 'Neither + aux + I' orqali beriladi.

lessons.title: Question Tags
lessons.explanation: Gap oxirida ishlatiladigan va tasdiq so'rovchi qisqa so'roqlar (shunday emasmi?).
lessons.rule: Darak gap -> Inkor tag | Inkor gap -> Darak tag.
lessons.formula: Positive sentence, negative tag? | Negative sentence, positive tag?

examples.en: You are a developer, aren't you?
She doesn't drive, does she?

quiz.questionUz: Tag qismini to'ldiring: 'They went to the cinema, ___?'
quiz.explanation: Past Simple darak gap uchun tag 'didn't + pronoun' bo'ladi.

lessons.title: Too / Enough
lessons.explanation: Me'yoridan ortiqcha (Too) yoki yetarli darajada (Enough) ekanligini bildirish.
lessons.rule: Too + Sifat | Sifat + Enough | Enough + Ot
lessons.formula: too + Adj | Adj + enough | enough + Noun

examples.en: This tea is too hot to drink.
examples.uz: Bu choy ichish uchun juda issiq.

examples.en: He is old enough to drive.
examples.uz: U mashina haydash uchun yetarli darajada yoshga to'lgan.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri o'rinni tanlang: 'I don't have ___ to buy this phone.'
quiz.explanation: 'Enough' ot so'z birikmalarida otdan OLDIN keladi.

lessons.title: Defining vs Non-defining Relative Clauses
lessons.explanation: Muhim ma'lumot beruvchi (Defining) va qo'shimcha ajratilgan ma'lumot beruvchi (Non-defining) ergash gaplar.
lessons.rule: Non-defining vergul bilan ajratiladi va ularda 'that' ishlatib bo'lmaydi.
lessons.formula: Main clause, who/which + extra info, verb...

examples.en: My brother, who lives in London, is an engineer.

quiz.questionUz: Qaysi nisbiy olmosh vergul bilan ajratilgan (Non-defining) gaplarda ISHLATILMAYDI?
quiz.explanation: Vergul bilan ajratilgan Non-defining nisbiy gaplarda 'that' ishlatilmaydi.

lessons.title: Subject & Object Questions
lessons.explanation: Egani topishga qaratilgan (Subject) va to'ldiruvchini topishga qaratilgan (Object) so'roq gaplar.
lessons.rule: Ega so'ralganda 'do/does/did' ko'makchi fe'llari ishlatilmaydi.
lessons.formula: Subject Ques: Who/What + Verb? | Object Ques: Who/What + aux + Subject + Verb?

examples.en: Who called you? (Subject: Kim qo'ng'iroq qildi?)
Who did you call? (Object: Kimga qo'ng'iroq qilding?)

quiz.questionUz: Egani topish uchun to'g'ri berilgan savolni tanlang (Who wrote the letter?):
quiz.explanation: Subject question'da Yordamchi fe'l (did) ishlatilmaydi, asosiy fe'l o'tgan zamonda qoladi.

lessons.title: Phrasal Verbs: Separable & Inseparable
lessons.explanation: Fe'l va predlog birikmasidan hosil bo mezon keladigan, ajraladigan va ajralmaydigan frazali fe'llar.
lessons.rule: Ajraladigan (Separable): turn it off | Ajralmaydigan (Inseparable): look for him.
lessons.formula: Verb + Preposition / Verb + Object + Preposition

examples.en: Please turn off the TV / Please turn the TV off.
I am looking for my keys. (Inseparable)

quiz.questionUz: Olmosh ishlatilganda qaysi birikma to'g'ri? (turn off)
quiz.explanation: Olmosh (it) kelganda ajraladigan frazali fe'l o'rtasiga tushadi.

lessons.title: Connectors of Contrast & Purpose
lessons.explanation: Zidlov va maqsadni bog'lovchi so'zlar (although, despite, in order to, so that).
lessons.rule: Although + Ega + Fe'l | Despite + Ot/Gerund | In order to + Verb1
lessons.formula: Contrast: Although S+V / Despite + Noun | Purpose: In order to + V1

examples.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ayotganiga qaramay, biz ko'chaga chiqdik.

examples.en: He studied hard in order to pass the exam.
examples.uz: U imtihondan o'tish uchun qattiq o'rgandi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri bog'lovchini tanlang: '___ the rain, we played football.'
quiz.explanation: Ketidan bevosita ot ('the rain') kelgani uchun 'Despite' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Wish Clauses: Present & Future Wishes
lessons.explanation: Hozirgi zamondagi afsuslar va nimadandir norozilikni bilgirish (I wish...)
lessons.rule: Hozirgi holat haqida afsuslanish: I wish + Past Simple | O'zgarishni xohlash: I wish + would
lessons.formula: I wish + Subject + Past Simple / would + V1

examples.en: I wish I had more free time.
examples.uz: Kattaroq/ko'proq bo'sh vaqtim bo'lishini xohlardim (lekin yo'q).

examples.en: I wish it would stop raining.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'I wish I ___ (know) his phone number.'
quiz.explanation: Hozirgi afsus uchun 'wish'dan keyin Past Simple (knew) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Third Conditional
lessons.explanation: O'tmishdagi amalga oshmagan gipotetik holatlar va ularning o'tmishdagi gipotetik natijalari hamda afsuslar.
lessons.rule: If + Past Perfect, Subject + would have + Verb3
lessons.formula: If + S + had + V3, S + would have + V3

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
examples.uz: Agar qattiqroq o'qiganimda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'lardim.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'If they ___ earlier, they wouldn't have missed the train.'
quiz.explanation: Third Conditional shart qismida Past Perfect (had left) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Mixed Conditionals
lessons.explanation: O'tmishdagi gipotetik shartning hozirgi zamondagi natijasi yoki hozirgi doimiy holatning o'tmishdagi natijasi.
lessons.rule: Past Condition -> Present Result: If + Past Perfect, Subject + would + Verb1
lessons.formula: If + S + had + V3, S + would + V1 (now)

examples.en: If I had taken that job, I would be living in London now.
examples.uz: Agar o'sha ishga kirganimda, hozir Londonda yashayotgan bo'lardim.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: 'If I had slept well last night, I ___ tired now.'
quiz.explanation: O'tmishdagi sababning hozirgi natijasi uchun 'would + V1' (wouldn't be) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Wish Clauses: Past Regrets
lessons.explanation: O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan yoki bo'lmagan voqealarga nisbatan afsuslanish (I wish / If only).
lessons.rule: I wish / If only + Subject + Past Perfect (had + V3)
lessons.formula: I wish + S + had + V3

examples.en: I wish I hadn't sold my old car.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'If only I ___ (buy) Bitcoin in 2012!'
quiz.explanation: O'tmishdagi afsus uchun 'had + V3' (had bought) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Passive Voice: All Continuous & Perfect Tenses
lessons.explanation: Davomli (Continuous) va tugallangan (Perfect) zamonlarda majhul nisbat qo'llanilishi.
lessons.rule: Continuous: be + being + V3 | Perfect: have/has/had + been + V3
lessons.formula: Continuous: am/is/are/was/were + being + V3 | Perfect: have/has/had + been + V3

examples.en: My car is being repaired right now.
The report has been completed.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri Majhul shaklni tanlang: 'A new stadium ___ in our city at the moment.'
quiz.explanation: Hozir sodir bo'layotgan majhul harakat uchun Present Continuous Passive (is being built) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Causative Form: Have / Get something done
lessons.explanation: Biror xizmat yoki ishni o'zi emas, boshqa bir kishiga qildirganlikni ifodalash.
lessons.rule: Subject + have/get + object + Verb3
lessons.formula: S + have/get + Object + V3

examples.en: I had my hair cut yesterday.
She is getting her phone repaired.

quiz.questionUz: Kavsativ shaklni to'ldiring: 'We need to get our roof ___ (repair).'
quiz.explanation: 'Get + object + V3' qoidasi bo'yicha 'repaired' shakli tushadi.

lessons.title: Reported Speech: Questions & Commands
lessons.explanation: So'roq va buyruq gaplarni o'zlashtirma gapga aylantirish.
lessons.rule: Yes/No Qs -> ask if/whether | Wh Qs -> ask Wh-word + S + V | Commands -> tell/ask + to + V1
lessons.formula: Ask + if/wh + S + V | Tell + Person + to + V1

examples.en: Direct: 'Where do you live?' -> Reported: He asked me where I lived.
Direct: 'Be quiet!' -> Reported: The teacher told us to be quiet.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri o'zlashtirma savolni tanlang: 'Are you ready?'
options: He asked if I was ready.
He asked if am I ready.
He told if I was ready.
quiz.answer: He asked if I was ready.
quiz.explanation: Yes/No savollar 'if' va darak gap tartibi (I was ready) bilan o'zlashtiriladi.

lessons.title: Reporting Verbs with Structures
lessons.explanation: 'Say' va 'Tell' so'zlaridan tashqari maxsus strukturaga ega xabar fe'llari (suggest, deny, offer, warn...).
lessons.rule: offer/promise + to V1 | deny/suggest + V-ing | advise/warn + Object + to V1
lessons.formula: Verb + to V1 / Verb + V-ing / Verb + Object + to V1

examples.en: He denied stealing the money.
She offered to help us.
examples.uz: U bizga yordam berishni taklif qildi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'He suggested ___ to the cinema.'
quiz.explanation: 'Suggest' fe'lidan keyin obyekt bo'lmasa, harakat 'V-ing' (going) shaklida keladi.

lessons.title: Modal Verbs of Past Deduction: must have, can't have, might have
lessons.explanation: O'tmishdagi voqealar haqida mantiqiy taxmin va xulosalar chiqarish.
lessons.rule: Must have + V3 (90% ishonch) | Can't have + V3 (O'tmishda imkonsiz) | Might have + V3 (Ehtimol)
lessons.formula: Subject + must/can't/might/could + have + V3

examples.en: He failed the test. He must have been unprepared.
examples.uz: U imtihondan yiqildi. U tayyorgarlik ko'rmagan bo'lsa kerak.

examples.en: You can't have seen him yesterday; he is abroad.
examples.uz: Siz uni kecha ko'rgan bo'lishingiz mumkin emas, u chet elda.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri modal shaklni tanlang: 'The ground is wet. It ___ rained last night.'
quiz.explanation: Yer ho'lligi kechasi yomg'ir yog'ganiga o'tmishdagi kuchli dalil bo'ladi (must have).

lessons.title: Should have / Shouldn't have (Past Criticism)
lessons.explanation: O'tmishdagi xatolar, bajarilmagan majburiyatlar va afsuslar uchun tanqidiy fikr bildirish.
lessons.rule: Subject + should / shouldn't + have + Verb3
lessons.formula: S + should/shouldn't + have + V3

examples.en: I failed the exam. I should have studied more.
examples.uz: Imtihondan yiqildim. Ko'proq dars qilishim kerak edi (lekin qilmadim).

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'You ___ (should / not / eat) so much junk food last night.'
quiz.explanation: O'tmishdagi noto'g'ri ishni tanqid qilish uchun 'shouldn't have + V3' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Future Continuous & Future Perfect
lessons.explanation: Kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtda davom etayotgan harakat (Continuous) va kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtgacha yakunlanadigan harakat (Perfect).
lessons.rule: Future Cont: will be + V-ing | Future Perf: will have + V3
lessons.formula: Future Cont: S + will be + V-ing | Future Perf: S + will have + V3

examples.en: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Tokyo.
examples.uz: Ertaga shu vaqtda Tokyoga uchib ketayotgan bo'laman.

examples.en: By next year, I will have graduated from university.
examples.uz: Kelasi yilgacha men universitetni bitirib bo'laman.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri zamonni tanlang: 'By the time you arrive, I ___ cooking.'
quiz.explanation: 'By the time' signal so'zi kelajakda aniq vaqtgacha tugaydigan jarayon (Future Perfect) uchun mos keladi.

lessons.title: Participle Clauses (-ing and -ed)
lessons.explanation: Gaplarni qisqartirish va bog'lovchilarsiz murakkab gaplar tuzish usuli.
lessons.rule: Active meaning -> Present Participle (-ing) | Passive meaning -> Past Participle (-ed)
lessons.formula: Verb(-ing) / Verb(-ed), Main Clause

examples.en: Feeling tired, he went to bed early.
examples.uz: O'zini charchagan his qilib, u erta uyquga ketdi.

examples.en: Built in 1920, the house needed repair.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri sifatdoshni tanlang: '___ all the money, he couldn't buy food.'
quiz.explanation: Harakat asosiy voqeadan oldin tugagani uchun Perfect Participle 'Having spent' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Inversion for Emphasis
lessons.explanation: Inkor va salbiy ravishlar gap boshiga chiqqanda gap tartibining so'roq shakliga o'zgarishi (Urghu berish).
lessons.rule: Negative Word + Auxiliary Verb + Subject + Main Verb
lessons.formula: Never/Hardly/Seldom + aux + Subject + Verb

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
examples.uz: Hech qachon bunday go'zal joyni ko'rmaganman (urg'u bilan).

quiz.questionUz: Inversiyali gapning to'g'ri shaklini tanlang:
options: Hardly had I arrived when it started raining.
Hardly I had arrived when it started raining.
Hardly I arrived when it started raining.
Hardly did I arrived when it started raining.
quiz.answer: Hardly had I arrived when it started raining.
quiz.explanation: 'Hardly' gap boshida kelganda yordamchi fe'l 'had' egadan oldinga o'tadi.

lessons.title: Complex Infiative & Complex Object
lessons.explanation: Murakkab to'ldiruvchi qurilmasi (want/expect/allow somebody to do something).
lessons.rule: Subject + Verb + Object + to-infinitive / bare infinitive
lessons.formula: S + Verb + Person + (to) V1

examples.en: He made me laugh. (bare infinitive)
I want you to succeed. (to-infinitive)

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: 'My parents didn't let me ___ out late.'
quiz.explanation: 'Let' fe'lidan keyin kelgan obyektdan so'ng 'to'siz fe'l (bare infinitive) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Subjunctive Mood
lessons.explanation: Rasmiy takliflar, talablar va muhim istaklarni ifodalovchi fe'l mayli.
lessons.rule: demand / suggest / recommend / insist + that + Subject + Verb1 (boshlang'ich)
lessons.formula: S + demand/suggest + that + S + V1 (base form)

examples.en: The doctor recommended that he stop smoking.
examples.uz: Shifokor unga chekishni tashlashni maslahat berdi ('stops' emas).

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'I insist that she ___ present at the meeting.'
quiz.explanation: Subjunctive mood qoidasi bo'yicha 'that'dan keyin fe'lning sof ko'rinishi (be) ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Articles: Advanced Rules & Zero Article
lessons.explanation: Geografik nomlar, muassasa nomlari va abstrakt tushunchalar bilan artikllarning maxsus ishlatilishi.
lessons.rule: The + Okeanlar, Tog' tizmalari | Artiklsiz: Qit'alar, Ko'llar, Bitta tog'.
lessons.formula: the + Group of Islands/Mountains | Zero article + Single Lake/Mountain

examples.en: They climbed Mount Everest last summer. (Zero article)
examples.uz: Ular o'tgan yozda Everest tog'iga chiqishdi.

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean. (The)

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri artiklni tanlang: '___ United Kingdom consists of four countries.'
quiz.explanation: Tarkibida 'Kingdom', 'States', 'Republic' bo'lgan mamlakat nomlari 'The' artiklini oladi.

lessons.title: Nouns with Prepositions (Prepositional Phrases)
lessons.explanation: Otlardan keyin qat'iy birikib keladigan va ma'lum ma'noni ifodalaydigan predloglar.
lessons.rule: Noun + specific preposition (e.g., solution to, reason for, increase in)
lessons.formula: Noun + Preposition

examples.en: There is a need for more green energy.
What was the cause of the accident?

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri predlogni yozing: 'Scientists are looking for a solution ___ global warming.'
quiz.explanation: 'Solution' otidan keyin har doim 'to' predlogi ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Adjectives with Prepositions
lessons.explanation: Sifatlardan keyin qat'iy birikadigan predloglar.
lessons.rule: Adjective + specific preposition (e.g., interested in, good at, famous for)
lessons.formula: Adj + Preposition

examples.en: She is famous for her books.
Are you aware of the risks?

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri predlogni tanlang: 'He is very keen ___ learning new technologies.'
quiz.explanation: 'Keen' sifatidan keyin 'on' predlogi ishlatiladi (keen on).

lessons.title: Advanced Discourse Markers & Connectors
lessons.explanation: Insho va akademik nutqda fikrlarni bog'lovchi ilg'or iboralar (furthermore, nevertheless, consequently).
lessons.rule: Furthermore (qo'shimcha) | Nevertheless (lekin/shunga qaramay) | Consequently (natijada)
lessons.formula: Sentence 1. Discourse Marker, Sentence 2.

examples.en: The system is fast. Furthermore, it is very secure.
examples.uz: Tizim tezkor. Qolaversa, u juda xavfsiz.

quiz.questionUz: Qaysi so'z natijani ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi?
quiz.explanation: 'Consequently' so'zi 'natijada / oqibatda' degan ma'noni beradi.

lessons.title: Unreal Past: It's time / Would rather
lessons.explanation: Hozirgi vaqt uchun gipotetik o'tgan zamon shakllarini qo'llash.
lessons.rule: It's time + Subject + Past Simple | Would rather + Subject + Past Simple
lessons.formula: It's high time + S + V2 | S + would rather + S + V2

examples.en: It's high time we started working.
examples.uz: Ishni boshlash vaqti keldi (o'tib ham ketdi).

examples.en: I'd rather you didn't smoke here.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'It is time we ___ (go) home.'
quiz.explanation: 'It's time + S' konstruksiyasidan keyin fe'l Past Simple (went) shaklida bo'ladi.

lessons.title: Emphasis: Cleft Sentences (It is... that / What... is)
lessons.explanation: Gapning ma'lum bir qismiga e'tiborni tortish va urg'u berish usuli.
lessons.rule: It is/was + emphasized part + that... | What + S + V + is/was...
lessons.formula: It was X that Y | What X did was Y

examples.en: It was Alex who solved the problem.
examples.uz: Muammoni hal qilgan odam aynan Aleks edi.

examples.en: What I love about coding is problem solving.
examples.uz: Dasturlashda menga eng yoqadigan narsa bu muammolarni hal qilishdir.

quiz.questionUz: Urg'uli (Cleft) gapni to'g'ri to'ldiring: 'What we need ___ more time.'
quiz.explanation: 'What' bilan boshlanuvchi birikmalarda fe'l ko'pincha birlikda 'is' bo'ladi.

lessons.title: Advanced Inversion (Locative & Negative)
lessons.explanation: Urg'uni oshirish yoki tasviriy uslub yaratish uchun o'rin-joy ravishlari va salbiy iboralar bilan murakkab inversiya.
lessons.rule: Locative: Place Prepositional Phrase + Verb + Subject | Negative: Under no circumstances + Aux + S + V
lessons.formula: Prepositional Phrase + Main Verb + Subject

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you share your password.
examples.uz: Hech qanday holatda parolingizni ulashmasligingiz kerak.

examples.en: At the top of the hill stood a ancient castle.
examples.uz: Tepalikning tepasida qadimiy qasr qad rostlab turardi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri inversiyali gapni tanlang:
options: On no account must this door be left open.
On no account this door must be left open.
On no account must be this door left open.
On no account this door must left open.
quiz.answer: On no account must this door be left open.
quiz.explanation: 'On no account' iborasidan keyin yordamchi/modal fe'l (must) egadan oldinga o'tadi.

lessons.title: Mixed & Advanced Conditionals with Supposition
lessons.explanation: Tuzilishida 'should', 'were to', yoki 'had' orqali gipotetik va ehtimoli juda past shartlarni ifodalash.
lessons.rule: Inverted Conditional: Were I to... / Had I known... / Should you need...
lessons.formula: Were + Subject + to V1 / Had + Subject + V3 / Should + Subject + V1

examples.en: Should you require further assistance, please contact us.
examples.uz: Mabodo qo'shimcha yordam kerak bo me'mor, biz bilan bog'laning.

examples.en: Had I known about the delay, I would have taken a different route.
examples.uz: Ushlanib qolishni bilganimda edi, boshqa yo'ldan ketgan bo'lardim.

quiz.questionUz: Inversiyali shart gapni to'ldiring: '___ (be) I in your position, I would accept the proposal.'
quiz.explanation: If qatnashmagan gipotetik holatlarda 'Were I...' formasi ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Advanced Passive: Impersonal & Personal Structures
lessons.explanation: Umumiy fikr yoki mish-mishlarni akademik uslubda ifodalash (It is said that... / He is thought to be...).
lessons.rule: It + Passive Verb + that clause OR Subject + Passive Verb + to-infinitive / Perfect Infinitive
lessons.formula: It is believed that + Clause | S + is believed + to V1 / to have V3

examples.en: It is reported that the company lost millions.
examples.uz: Kompaniya millionlab pul yo'qotgani xabar qilinmoqda.

examples.en: He is thought to have left the country yesterday.
examples.uz: U kecha mamlakatni tark etgan deb hisoblanmoqda.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'The suspect is believed ___ the border last night.'
quiz.explanation: O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan harakat uchun Perfect Infinitive ('to have crossed') qo'llaniladi.

lessons.title: Nominalisation (Academic Style)
lessons.explanation: Fe'l va sifatlarni otlarga aylantirish orqali matnni ko'proq rasmiy va akademik qilish usuli.
lessons.rule: Verb/Adjective -> Noun Phrase (e.g. analyze -> analysis, grow -> growth)
lessons.formula: Action Verb -> Abstract Noun

examples.en: We analyzed the data. -> An analysis of the data was conducted.

quiz.questionUz: 'The government decided to reduce taxes' gapining nominal shaklini toping:
options: The decision was made to reduce taxes.
The government made a reduction in taxes.
A tax reduction decision was made.
quiz.answer: The government made a reduction in taxes.
quiz.explanation: Fe'llarni ot holatiga o'tkazish (reduce -> reduction) akademik uslub belgisidir.

lessons.title: Advanced Participle & Absolute Clauses
lessons.explanation: O'zining alohida egasiga ega bo'lgan va asosiy gap bilan bog'langan mustaqil sifatdoshli qurilmalar.
lessons.rule: Noun + Participle (-ing / -ed / having + V3), Main Clause
lessons.formula: Subject1 + Participle, Subject2 + Verb

examples.en: Weather permitting, we will host the event outdoors.
examples.uz: Ob-havo yo'l qo'ysa, tadbirni ochiq havoda o'tkazamiz.

examples.en: The meeting having ended, everyone left the room.
examples.uz: Majlis tugagach, hamma xonani tark etdi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri birikmani tanlang: 'The work ___, we decided to celebrate.'
quiz.explanation: Absolute clause qurilmasida o'tmishda tugallangan majhul harakat uchun 'having been + V3' qo'llaniladi.

lessons.title: Subjunctive with 'It is essential/vital that...'
lessons.explanation: O'ta muhim, zaruriy yoki rasmiy talablarni ifodalovchi gap qurilmalari.
lessons.rule: It is essential/crucial/imperative that + Subject + Infinitive (base form)
lessons.formula: It is + Adjective + that + S + V1

examples.en: It is crucial that he be informed immediately.
examples.uz: Unga zudlik bilan xabar berilishi juda muhim.

examples.en: It is imperative that every candidate sign the agreement.
examples.uz: Har bir nomzod shartnomani imzolashi shart.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri fe'l shaklini yozing: 'It is essential that she ___ (submit) the report on time.'
quiz.explanation: Subjunctive mood qoidasiga ko'ra fe'l uchinchi shaxsda bo'lsa ham 's' qo'shimchasisiz (submit) yoziladi.

lessons.title: Advanced Relative Clauses (Preposition + Relative Pronoun)
lessons.explanation: Predloglar nisbiy olmoshlardan oldin keladigan rasmiy akademik birikmalar (whom, which).
lessons.rule: Preposition + whom (for people) / which (for things)
lessons.formula: Noun + Preposition + whom/which + Clause

examples.en: The manager to whom I spoke was very helpful.
examples.uz: Men gaplashgan menejer juda yordam berdi.

examples.en: The project in which we invested failed.
examples.uz: Biz sarmoya kiritgan loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri nisbiy olmoshni tanlang: 'This is the company in ___ I used to work.'
quiz.explanation: Predlogdan (in) keyin 'that' qo'llanmaydi, narsalar uchun 'which' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Quantifiers with Relative Clauses (all of which, none of whom)
lessons.explanation: Guruhlar yoki ob'ektlarning miqdorini aks ettiruvchi nisbiy birikmalar.
lessons.rule: Number/Quantifier + of + which / whom
lessons.formula: Quantifier (some/all/none/most) + of + which/whom

examples.en: He wrote three books, none of which were published.
examples.uz: U uchta kitob yozdi, ularning hech biri nashr etilmadi.

examples.en: They interviewed 20 candidates, most of whom were qualified.
examples.uz: Ular 20 ta nomzodni suhbatdan o'tkazishdi, ularning aksariyati malakali edi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'She has two brothers, both ___ live in Canada.'
quiz.explanation: Odamlarga nisbatan va qo'shimcha relative clause bilan ulash uchun 'of whom' ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Double Inversion & Complex Negative Structures
lessons.explanation: Bitta gap ichida ikkita salbiy yoki inversiyali strukturalarning birga qo'llanilishi.
lessons.rule: Not only + Aux + S + V..., but also... | Scarcely... when...
lessons.formula: Not only + Aux + S + V, but S + also + V

examples.en: Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the top score.
examples.uz: U nafaqat imtihondan o'tdi, balki eng yuqori ballni ham qo'lga kiritdi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri davomini tanlang: 'Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the key.'
quiz.explanation: 'Not only' gap boshida kelganda so'roq gap tartibi (did he arrive) qo'llaniladi.

lessons.title: Advanced Modal Extensions: Needn't have vs Didn't need to
lessons.explanation: O'tmishda bajarilgan ammo keraksiz bo'lgan harakatlar hamda kerak bo'lmagani uchun bajarilmagan harakatlar farqi.
lessons.rule: Needn't have V3 (Bajarildi, lekin kerak emasdi) vs Didn't need to V1 (Kerak emasdi, bajarilmadi)
lessons.formula: S + needn't have + V3 vs S + didn't need to + V1

examples.en: I needn't have bought milk; we already had plenty.
examples.uz: Sut sotib olmasam ham bo'larkan, uyda ko'p edi (lekin olib qo'ydim).

examples.en: I didn't need to wake up early, so I slept in.
examples.uz: Erta turishim shart emasdi, shuning uchun uxlab yotdim (turmadim).

quiz.questionUz: Qaysi biri 'Harakat bajarildi, ammo ortiqcha edi' degan ma'noni beradi?
quiz.explanation: 'Needn't have + V3' – keraksiz ish bajarib bo'linganini anglatadi.

lessons.title: Advanced Ellipsis & Substitution
lessons.explanation: Takrorlanishning oldini olish uchun gap elementlarini tushirib qoldirish yoki o'rniga boshqa so'zlardan foydalanish.
lessons.rule: Ellipsis (Tushirib qoldirish) | Substitution (do so, so, not, ones)
lessons.formula: Auxiliary Verb alone / 'to' infinitive marker alone

examples.en: Are you coming? - I hope so.
He asked me to help him, and I did so.
examples.uz: U yordam berishimni so'radi va men shunday qildim.

quiz.questionUz: Qisqartma variantni to'ldiring: 'Will it rain tomorrow? - I hope ___.'
quiz.explanation: 'I hope not' – salbiy taxminlar uchun ishlatiladigan rasmiy substitutsiya.

lessons.title: Advanced Emphatic Structures (Wh- clefts with 'All')
lessons.explanation: 'All' va 'What' yordamida harakat yoki xohishga o'ta kuchli urg'u berish.
lessons.rule: All + Subject + Verb + is/was + Infinitive
lessons.formula: All I want is... | All he did was...

examples.en: All I need is a bit of peace and quiet.
examples.uz: Menga kerak bo'lgan yagona narsa bu ozgina tinchlik va osoyishtalik.

examples.en: All he did was complain about the service.
examples.uz: Uning qilgan yagona ishi xizmat ko'rsatishdan shikoyat qilish bo'ldi.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri urg'uli gapni tanlang:
options: All she wants is to pass the exam.
All what she wants is to pass.
All that what she wants is to pass.
All she want is pass the exam.
quiz.answer: All she wants is to pass the exam.
quiz.explanation: 'All S + V + is' strukturasida ortiqcha 'what' qo'shilmaydi.

lessons.title: Gerunds with Passives & Perfect Structures
lessons.explanation: Majhul va tugallangan shakldagi murakkab gerundiy birikmalari.
lessons.rule: Passive Gerund: being + V3 | Perfect Gerund: having + V3 | Passive Perfect: having been + V3
lessons.formula: being + V3 / having + V3 / having been + V3

examples.en: He resented being treated like a child.
examples.uz: U o'ziga bolalarcha munosabatda bo'lishlaridan xafa bo'ldi.

examples.en: She admitted having made a mistake.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri shaklni tanlang: 'He avoided ___ by the police.'
quiz.explanation: Majhul harakat va 'avoid' fe'lidan keyin 'being + V3' qo'llaniladi.

lessons.title: Advanced Concession & Contrast Markers
lessons.explanation: Zidlikni ifodalash uchun qo'llaniladigan murakkab bog'lovchi iboralar.
lessons.rule: Albeit + Adjective | Much as + S + V | Be that as it may
lessons.formula: Much as + Subject + Verb | Albeit + Adjective/Adverb

examples.en: It was an enjoyable, albeit expensive, vacation.
examples.uz: Bu maroqli, garchi qimmat bo'lsa-da, ta'til bo'ldi.

examples.en: Much as I respect him, I cannot agree with his choice.
examples.uz: Uni qancha hurmat qilsam ham, tanloviga qo'shila olmayman.

quiz.questionUz: To'g'ri bog'lovchini tanlang: 'He accepted the job, ___ the salary was low.'
quiz.explanation: To'liq ergash gap (the salary was low) uchun 'although' to'g'ri keladi.

lessons.title: Complex Prepositional Phrases & Idiomatic Linking
lessons.explanation: Rasmiy insholar va nutqda g'oyalarni akademik bog'lash uchun ishlatiladigan birikmalar.
lessons.rule: In light of / With a view to + V-ing / In terms of / On account of
lessons.formula: Prepositional Idiom + Noun / V-ing

examples.en: In light of recent events, the policy has changed.
examples.uz: So'nggi voqealarni hisobga olgan holda, siyosat o'zgardi.

examples.en: He studied hard with a view to getting a scholarship.
examples.uz: U stipendiya olish maqsadida qattiq o'qidi.

quiz.questionUz: 'with a view to' birikmasidan keyin fe'l qaysi shaklda keladi?
quiz.explanation: 'With a view to' iborasidagi 'to' predlog bo'lgani uchun fe'l 'V-ing' shaklida keladi.

lessons.title: Conditionals without 'If' (Provided, Supposing, As long as)
lessons.explanation: 'If' so'zisiz shart gaplar hosil qiluvchi alternativ bog'lovchilar.
lessons.rule: Provided (that) / Supposing (that) / On condition that / As long as + Present Simple, Future Simple
lessons.formula: Condition Conjunction + S + V1, S + will + V1

examples.en: Supposing you lost your job, what would you do?
examples.uz: Faraz qilaylik, kuningizdan ayrildingiz, nima qilgan bo'lardingiz?

examples.en: You can stay provided that you keep quiet.
examples.uz: Jim turishing sharti bilan qolishing mumkin.

quiz.questionUz: Qaysi so'z 'agar / faraz qilaylik' ma'nosini beradi?
quiz.explanation: 'Supposing' gipotetik shart qo'yish uchun ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Advanced Distance Forms & Detachment (It seems/appears)
lessons.explanation: Akademik nutqda xulosani yumshatish va o'z nuqtai nazaridan masofa saqlash.
lessons.rule: It appears/seems that + Clause OR Subject + appears/seems + to-infinitive
lessons.formula: It seems that + Clause | Subject + appears + to V1 / to have V3

examples.en: It would appear that the estimates were incorrect.
The issue appears to have been resolved.

quiz.questionUz: Gapni to'ldiring: 'It would ___ (appear) that mistakes were made.'
quiz.explanation: 'It would appear that...' formasi akademik ma'noni yumshatish uchun qo'llaniladi.

lessons.title: Discourse Markers for Perspective & Rephrasing
lessons.explanation: Nutqda fikrni qayta ifodalash, boshqa rakursdan qarash va aniqlik kiritish kabi vositalar.
lessons.rule: In other words / Namely / That is to say / Alternatively
lessons.formula: Sentence 1. In other words, Sentence 2.

examples.en: The country is experiencing high inflation; in other words, prices are rising fast.
examples.uz: Mamlakatda yuqori inflyatsiya kuzatilmoqda; boshqacha aytganda, narxlar tez o'smoqda.

quiz.questionUz: Fikrni boshqacha so'zlar bilan tushuntirish uchun qaysi birikma ishlatiladi?
quiz.explanation: 'In other words' – 'boshqacha aytganda' degan ma'noni beradi va qayta ta'riflash uchun xizmat qiladi.

lessons.title: Hedging in Academic & Formal English
lessons.explanation: Fikr va da'volarni o'ta qat'iy bildirmaslik, ularni muloyimlashtirish (Hedging) strategiyasi.
lessons.rule: Modal Verbs (tends to, may, could) + Distance Verbs (suggest, indicate) + Adverbs (arguably, presumably)
lessons.formula: Subject + tends to / seems to + Verb | Arguably, Subject + Verb

examples.en: The data suggests that social media tends to affect sleep patterns.
examples.uz: Ma'lumotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar uyqu rejimiga ta'sir qilish ehtimoli bor.

examples.en: This is arguably the most complex topic.

quiz.questionUz: Qaysi so'z ilmiy/akademik matnda taxminni yumshatish (hedging) uchun qo'llanadi?
quiz.explanation: 'Arguably' – 'bahsli ravishda / taxminan' degan ma'noni anglatib, fikrni ehtiyotkorlik bilan bildirishga yordam beradi.

lessons.title: Mastery Review: Complex Text Cohesion & Coherence
lessons.explanation: Barcha grammatik va uslubiy vositalarni birlashtirgan holda mukammal va izchil akademik matn yaratish.
lessons.rule: Cohesion (Grammatik bog'liqlik) + Coherence (Mantiqiy izchillik)
lessons.formula: Advanced Grammar + Lexical Chains + Strategic Connectors

examples.en: All things considered, having analyzed the outcomes, we must conclude that further research is required.
examples.uz: Barcha omillarni hisobga olgan holda va natijalarni tahlil qilib, biz kelajakda qo'shimcha izlanishlar zarur degan xulosaga kelishimiz kerak.

quiz.questionUz: Matnning Grammatik va Mantiqiy uzviyligini ta'minlovchi asosiy tushunchalar nima deb ataladi?
quiz.explanation: Matnning o'zaro bog'liqligi va mantiqiy ravonligi Cohesion va Coherence hisoblanadi.

flashcards.definitionUz: Ingliz tilidagi oddiy gaplarning asosiy so'z tartibi structure-i.
flashcards.example: I (Subject) eat (Verb) an apple (Object).

flashcards.definitionUz: Imkoniyat, majburiyat va maslahatni ifodalovchi yordamchi fe'llar.
flashcards.example: You should study grammar every day.

flashcards.definitionUz: Sifatlarning qiyosiy darajasi (-er yoki 'more' bilan).
flashcards.example: English is easier than you think!

flashcards.definitionUz: Tegishlilik va egalikni ko'rsatadigan sifatlar.
flashcards.example: My name is Kamron.

flashcards.definitionUz: Insonning qayerdan yoki qaysi mamlakatdan ekanligini so'rash struktura-si.
flashcards.example: Where are you from?

flashcards.definitionUz: Kelib chiqish yoki joyni ko'rsatuvchi predlog.
flashcards.example: I am from Uzbekistan.

flashcards.definitionUz: Sanaladigan birlikdagi otlar, kasb va maqomlar oldidan ishlatiladigan artikllar.
flashcards.example: I am a university student.

flashcards.definitionUz: Odatga aylangan doimiy holat va harakatlarni ifodalash.
flashcards.example: I live in a big city.

flashcards.definitionUz: Yoqtirgan mashg'ulot yoki xobbini ifodalash formulasi.
flashcards.example: I like listening to music.

flashcards.definitionUz: Juda kuchli yoqtirilgan faoliyatni bildirish.
flashcards.example: I love reading books.

flashcards.definitionUz: Yaqin masofadagi birlikdagi narsa yoki shaxsni ko'rsatish ko'rsatkich olmoshi.
flashcards.example: This is my friend.

flashcards.definitionUz: Uzoq masofadagi birlikdagi narsani ko'rsatish ko'rsatkich olmoshi.
flashcards.example: That is my house.

flashcards.definitionUz: Egalik va biror narsaga ega ekanlikni bildirish fe'li.
flashcards.example: I have a brother / She has a beautiful bag.

flashcards.definitionUz: Birlikdagi biror narsa yoki shaxsning mavjudligini ko'rsatish.
flashcards.example: There is a book on the table.

flashcards.definitionUz: Ko'plikdagi narsalarning mavjudligini ko'rsatish.
flashcards.example: There are two chairs in the room.

flashcards.definitionUz: Aniq soat va vaqtni ko'rsatishda 'at' predlogidan foydalanish.
flashcards.example: I get up at seven o'clock.

flashcards.definitionUz: Har kuni takrorlanadigan kunlik tartiblarni ifodalash.
flashcards.example: I go to university every day.

flashcards.definitionUz: He, She, It egalaridan so'ng fe'lga -s yoki -es qo'shimchasi qo'shilishi.
flashcards.example: He plays football.

flashcards.definitionUz: We, They va ko'plik egalarida fe'l o'zining asosiy shaklida ishlatilishi.
flashcards.example: We study English together.

flashcards.definitionUz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonning inkor shakli.
flashcards.example: I don't understand.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biroidan yordam yoki iltimos so'rashda 'Can' modal fe'li.
flashcards.example: Can you help me?

flashcards.definitionUz: Vaqtni va soatni so'rash iborasi.
flashcards.example: What time is it?

flashcards.definitionUz: Inson yoki narsaning jismoniy hamda ruhiy holatini ifodalash.
flashcards.example: I am hungry.

flashcards.definitionUz: Birgalikda biror ishni qilishga taklif kiritish shakli.
flashcards.example: Let's go home.

flashcards.definitionUz: Ayni daqiqada nima qilinayotganini so'rash strukturasi.
flashcards.example: What are you doing?

flashcards.definitionUz: Ayni gapirilayotgan vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan davomli harakat.
flashcards.example: I am watching a movie.

flashcards.definitionUz: O'tgan zamonda tugallangan aniq harakatlarni ifodalash.
flashcards.example: I went to the market yesterday.

flashcards.definitionUz: O'tgan vaqt birliklari bilan o'tgan zamon fe'llarining qo'llanilishi.
flashcards.example: We visited our friends last weekend.

flashcards.definitionUz: O'tgan zamonga oid so'roq gap tuzish formulasi.
flashcards.example: Did you enjoy the trip?

flashcards.definitionUz: O'tgan zamondagi inkor gaplar turlari.
flashcards.example: I didn't see him yesterday.

flashcards.definitionUz: O'tgan zamondagi davomli harakatni boshqa harakat bo'lib qo'yishi.
flashcards.example: I was studying when you called me.

flashcards.definitionUz: Oldindan rejalashtirilgan kelajakdagi maqsad va harakatlar.
flashcards.example: I am going to study tonight.

flashcards.definitionUz: Suhbat jarayonining o'zida qabul qilingan qaror va va'dalar.
flashcards.example: I will call you tomorrow.

flashcards.definitionUz: Maslahat va tavsiya berish modal fe'li.
flashcards.example: You should get some rest.

flashcards.definitionUz: Qat'iy majburiyat va ehtiyotkorlik kabi holatlar.
flashcards.example: You must be careful.

flashcards.definitionUz: Tashqi sharoit yoki qoidalar sababli majbur bo'lish.
flashcards.example: I have to finish my homework.

flashcards.definitionUz: Inkor gaplarda sanalmaydigan va ko'plikdagi otlar bilan qo'llanilishi.
flashcards.example: There isn't any milk in the fridge.

flashcards.definitionUz: Sanalmaydigan otlarning miqdorini so'rash.
flashcards.example: How much water do you drink?

flashcards.definitionUz: Sanaladigan otlarning sonini so'rash.
flashcards.example: How many books do you have?

flashcards.definitionUz: Ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlarni taqqoslashda 'more ... than' ishlatilishi.

flashcards.example: He looked as if he had seen a ghost.

flashcards.definitionUz: Kuchli maslahat yoki ogohlantirishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: You had better leave now.

flashcards.definitionUz: Bir variantni boshqasidan afzal ko‘rishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I'd rather stay home.

flashcards.definitionUz: Boshqa odamning biror ishni qilishini afzal ko‘rishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I'd rather you stayed here.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ishni qilish vaqti kelganini bildiradi.
flashcards.example: It's time we went home.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ish sodir bo‘lish ehtimoli yuqoriligini bildiradi.
flashcards.example: He is likely to win.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ish sodir bo‘lish ehtimoli pastligini bildiradi.
flashcards.example: It is unlikely to happen.

flashcards.definitionUz: Qiyinchilikka qaramay biror ishni uddalashni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I managed to finish the work.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ishni bajarishda muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘lishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: He failed to understand the question.

flashcards.definitionUz: Odatda shunday bo‘lish yoki qilish moyilligini bildiradi.
flashcards.example: People tend to worry about the future.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ishni qilishga tayyor yoki rozi bo‘lishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: She is willing to help us.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ishni qilish arziydiganligini bildiradi.
flashcards.example: This book is worth reading.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ishni qilmaslikka o‘zini tiya olmaslikni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I can't help laughing.

flashcards.definitionUz: Kelajakdagi voqeani intiqlik bilan kutishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I look forward to meeting you.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror faoliyatga qiziqishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I am interested in learning languages.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror faoliyatni yaxshi bajarish qobiliyatini bildiradi.
flashcards.example: She is good at speaking English.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ishda muvaffaqiyatga erishishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: He succeeded in passing the exam.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror kishini yoki narsani biror ishni qilishdan to‘sishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: The rain prevented us from playing.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror kishini biror ishda ayblashni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: They accused him of lying.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ish uchun uzr so‘rashda ishlatiladi.
flashcards.example: I apologized for being late.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ishni qilishni qat’iy talab qilishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: He insisted on paying.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror narsaga qarshi bo‘lishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I object to working on Sundays.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ish uchun mas’ul bo‘lishni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: He is responsible for managing the team.

flashcards.definitionUz: Biror ishni qilishda qiyinchilik bo‘lishini bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I have difficulty understanding him.

flashcards.definitionUz: Vaqtni biror ishga sarflashni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: I spend two hours studying every day.

flashcards.definitionUz: Never, rarely, seldom kabi so‘zlar gap boshida kelganda yordamchi fe’l egadan oldinga chiqadi.
flashcards.example: Rarely do we see such talent.

flashcards.definitionUz: Birinchi hodisa sodir bo‘lishi bilanoq ikkinchi hodisa yuz berganini ta’kidlaydi.
flashcards.example: Hardly had I arrived when it started raining.

flashcards.definitionUz: Bir hodisa sodir bo‘lishi bilanoq boshqa hodisa yuz berishini bildiradi.
flashcards.example: No sooner had he arrived than the meeting began.

flashcards.definitionUz: Hardly bilan o‘xshash ta’kidlangan vaqt tuzilmasidir.
flashcards.example: Scarcely had we sat down when the phone rang.

flashcards.definitionUz: Not only gap boshida kelganda inversion ishlatiladi.
flashcards.example: Not only did he win, but he also broke the record.

flashcards.definitionUz: Hech qanday sharoitda ham degan kuchli inkorni bildiradi.
flashcards.example: Under no circumstances should you open this door.

flashcards.definitionUz: Hech qachon yoki hech qanday holatda degan qat’iy ma’noni beradi.
flashcards.example: On no account should you tell him.

flashcards.definitionUz: Faqat ma’lum bir hodisadan keyin boshqa hodisa yuz berganini ta’kidlaydi.
flashcards.example: Only after the meeting did I understand the problem.

flashcards.definitionUz: Faqat ma’lum shart yoki vaqtda sodir bo‘lishni ta’kidlaydi.
flashcards.example: Only when I arrived did I realize the truth.

flashcards.definitionUz: Faqat shundan keyingina degan ta’kidni beradi.
flashcards.example: Only then did he understand.

flashcards.definitionUz: Gapiruvchi biror narsani bilmaganini kuchli ta’kid bilan bildiradi.
flashcards.example: Little did I know what would happen.

flashcards.definitionUz: Gapning muhim qismini ta’kidlash uchun What-clause ishlatiladi.
flashcards.example: What I need is more time.

flashcards.definitionUz: O‘tmishdagi asosiy ma’lumotni ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.
flashcards.example: What surprised me was his answer.

flashcards.definitionUz: Shaxsni alohida ta’kidlash uchun It was ... who ishlatiladi.
flashcards.example: It was Sarah who called me.

flashcards.definitionUz: Narsa yoki harakatni ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.
flashcards.example: It was the noise that woke me up.

flashcards.definitionUz: Gapning bir qismini ta’kidlash uchun uni odatdagi joyidan gap boshiga chiqarish.
flashcards.example: This book, I really enjoyed.

flashcards.definitionUz: Inkor ma’noli birikmani gap boshiga chiqarib ta’kidlaydi.
flashcards.example: Never before had I seen such a view.

flashcards.definitionUz: Ma’no tushunarli bo‘lganda takroriy so‘zlarni tushirib qoldirish.
flashcards.example: I can play the guitar, and my brother can too.

flashcards.definitionUz: Oldin aytilgan otni takrorlamaslik uchun one/ones ishlatiladi.
flashcards.example: I prefer the red one.

flashcards.definitionUz: Oldingi harakatni takrorlamaslik uchun do so yoki do it ishlatilishi mumkin.
flashcards.example: I asked him to leave, and he did so.

flashcards.definitionUz: Tasdiq fikrga qo‘shilishni rasmiyroq tarzda bildiradi.
flashcards.example: He can swim, and so can I.
